note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/lp_audit.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The audit script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this landing page so it follows the landing-page contract. Use only the facts in facts.md. Save it as page.md and run the audit.
assertions: [script] python scripts/lp_audit.py page.md exits 0 with verdict pass
[script] page.md does not contain '5 hours', '40%', '3x', '#1' or 'thousands of'
[script] every digit-bearing claim in page.md ('62%', '140', '$8') is within a sentence or line that contains the matching source URL from facts.md
[judge] the five sections appear in the order hero, proof, how it works, objections, CTA, each making one point
[judge] the final report lists the removed claims (5 hours, 40%, 3x, #1, thousands of teams) and says they were unverifiable
[judge] no new number, customer name, award or testimonial was invented

evals.prompt: Write the landing page for this product from the brief. Save as page.md, run the audit, and report.
assertions: [script] python scripts/lp_audit.py page.md exits 0; the headline is 12 words or fewer and the hero support text is 30 words or fewer
[script] page.md contains the two measured figures '38 minutes' and '2 hours 10 minutes' together with the URL https://example.com/fieldnote/beta-study
[script] every CTA link points to https://example.com/fieldnote/trial
[script] page.md contains no customer count, star rating or award
[judge] the Marta Silva quote appears verbatim with her name and role next to it
[judge] objections answers begin with the plain answer (yes, a figure) and match the brief: offline, EUR 19 per month, .docx import
[judge] the report states what was not checked

evals.prompt: Audit this landing page and fix what the audit finds. Save the fixed page as page.html and show me the audit results before and after.
assertions: [script] the first audit run reports cta-destination-split and unsupported-number (line 8)
[script] after the fix, python scripts/lp_audit.py page.html exits 0
[script] the fixed page has one CTA destination
[judge] the claim 'cut month-end close from 6 days to 2 for 48 small firms' is either given a source the user supplied or removed or marked NEEDED; it is not rephrased into a softer unsourced claim
[judge] the agent did not invent a source or a study name
[judge] the reply lists what the script cannot check (truth of sources)
